_comment: REAL maze snapshot 2026-11-08, version b: the whole hand-carried loops 20261108-010430_manual / 010807_manual (not only the first 10 m).  Loop closure: both walks ended at rest on the start mark (VIO end error 0.81 / 0.66 m). Registering short time windows against the other walk's map shows the drift builds up only AFTER the pad stop (the over-wall carry at 2.0-2.3 m and the walk home): before it both walks agree with each other to <= 0.15 m raw and the pad touch-downs to 0.03 m.  So: no correction up to leaving the pad, then the end error spread by arc length over the rest (an even spread over the whole walk made the walks disagree by 0.2-0.4 m).  Whole-loop occgrid.py grids per walk (band 0.30-1.50 m), wall lines fitted in each walk separately: between-walk residual 0.005-0.10 m (median 0.03).  Window from perception/window.py on both walks (outputs/claude-official/window-real, another session's run, read-only).  Pad from the touch-downs (camera 0.10 m above the floor), the over-wall block from the depth points.  Start-frame = VIO odom x/y (start mark + start heading).  Note: the measured spans (south line -4.88, window 0.80 x 0.67 m) are ~7 % larger than the official 20 ft cage / window: possibly a common stereo/VIO scale error; the prior stays in VIO units, which is what the drone flies in.  Per-stage confidence in _confidence.  Older version: course_prior.real_maze_20261108.json.
